name: rounds
description: Recurring agents that collect data from an issue tracker or a repository host, run a prompt through a language model, and store the result.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Agents keep reading their sources and writing results, but the runScript tool refuses to execute anything until the workspace is trusted.

rounds.enabled.markdownDescription: Master switch for scheduled runs. When off, agents only run when you start them manually.

rounds.timezone.markdownDescription: IANA time zone name used to evaluate schedules, daily limits and result file names, for example `Europe/Berlin`. Leave empty to use the system time zone. An agent may override this.

rounds.jitterSeconds.markdownDescription: Maximum random delay before a scheduled run. Spreading runs out reduces the chance that automated requests look like abuse to your model provider. Manual runs are never delayed.

rounds.maxExecutionsPerDay.markdownDescription: Maximum number of runs across all agents per local day. An agent may set a lower limit of its own.

rounds.minimumIntervalWarning.markdownDescription: Warn when a schedule fires more often than this many minutes.

enumDescriptions: Keep the already scheduled next run.
Recompute the next run from the time of the manual run.
rounds.manualRunNextRunPolicy.markdownDescription: What happens to the next scheduled run after you start an agent manually.

rounds.defaultOutputFolder.markdownDescription: Absolute path of the folder that receives result files. Leave empty to store them inside the extension's global storage. An agent may override this.

rounds.scriptWhitelist.markdownDescription:
Commands the `runScript` tool is allowed to execute. Nothing outside this list runs, so an empty list disables the tool.

Each entry names one command and the arguments it may be given. Arguments are matched **one for one**: an entry for `npm test` does not also allow `npm test --watch`. A pattern may end with `*` to accept any suffix, so `run lint*` allows `run lint` and `run lint:fix`.

```json
"rounds.scriptWhitelist": [
  { "command": "npm", "args": ["test"] },
  { "command": "npm", "args": ["run", "lint*"] },
  { "command": "git", "args": ["status", "--short"] }
]
```

Commands run directly, never through a shell, and only inside the workspace. `;`, `&&` and pipes are therefore ordinary text that matches no pattern rather than a way to chain commands.

command.description: Executable name or absolute path. Executed directly, never through a shell.

args.description: Allowed arguments, matched one for one against what the model asks for. A pattern may end with * to accept any suffix. Omit to allow the command with no arguments at all.

rounds.executionHistoryLimit.markdownDescription: How many runs to keep in the history of each agent. Result files are never deleted.

enumDescriptions: Use the stored snapshot of the prompt file when the file cannot be read.
Fail the run when the file cannot be read but a snapshot exists.
Always fail the run when the file cannot be read.
rounds.promptFileFallback.markdownDescription: What an agent does when its prompt file is missing or unreadable at run time.

enumDescriptions: Log everything, including tool calls and scheduling decisions.
rounds.logLevel.markdownDescription: Verbosity of the Rounds output channel.

enumDescriptions: Report failures only. Scheduled runs that succeed stay quiet.
Report every scheduled run, successful ones included.
Show no notifications. The output channel, the status bar and the run history are unchanged.
rounds.notifications.markdownDescription: How much Rounds may interrupt you. A run you start yourself always reports its outcome.

viewsWelcome.contents:
No agents yet. An agent visits a source on a schedule, runs your prompt through a language model and stores the result.
Agents run only while this editor is open.
[Create Agent](command:rounds.createAgent)
[Check Setup](command:rounds.checkSetup)

scripts.check: node scripts/check-language.mjs && node scripts/check-dependencies.mjs && node scripts/check-unit-tests.mjs && node scripts/check-consent-gate.mjs && node scripts/check-network.mjs
scripts.test:unit: node scripts/check-unit-tests.mjs && npm run compile:tests && mocha
scripts.test:coverage: node scripts/check-unit-tests.mjs && npm run compile:tests && c8 --config .c8rc.json mocha
scripts.test:integration: npm run compile && npm run compile:tests && vscode-test
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
